what: One run of the liquidity service (app.liquidity.service.LiquidityService.equity, coverage 0.5) for SPY, TLT and ITA with the Massive key. Saturday snapshot of Friday's data: daily and 5-minute bars end with the 2026-10-02 session; the spread is the last Massive quote, which on a Saturday is an after-hours/overnight quote (flagged in sources.spread). cs_spread_bp_daily_bars is the service's own Corwin-Schultz (2012) high-low estimate over the same 20 daily bars; the service does not use it when a quote exists, and it is kept here only as a cross-check.
script: a one-off call of the service from the backend venv; no server, no order

capacity.note: the largest holding whose hedge (coverage x holding) fits one order at the open (10% of the opening 5-minute volume) and one session (1% of ADV)

spread.note: last quote outside the regular session: its spread may be wider than at the open

capacity.note: the largest holding whose hedge (coverage x holding) fits one order at the open (10% of the opening 5-minute volume) and one session (1% of ADV)

spread.note: last quote outside the regular session: its spread may be wider than at the open

capacity.note: the largest holding whose hedge (coverage x holding) fits one order at the open (10% of the opening 5-minute volume) and one session (1% of ADV)

spread.note: last quote outside the regular session: its spread may be wider than at the open

caps.per_order: <= 10% of the opening 5-minute volume (median of the last 20 sessions)

cost_model.formula: cost_bp = half_spread_bp + k * sigma_daily * sqrt(q / ADV_shares) * 1e4
cost_model.k_source: square-root law; Toth et al. 2011 (Y ~ 0.5-1), Almgren et al. 2005 (~0.3-1): conservative end
cost_model.sigma_source: SD of the last 20 daily close-to-close log returns (Massive daily bars)
cost_model.spread_source: Massive last NBBO quote; else the Corwin-Schultz (2012) high-low estimate from daily bars

option_and_pm.what: Same service, second call at run_at_utc: GET /liquidity/option for the SPY 650 put expiring 2026-12-18 (Massive snapshot, Friday's volume and open interest, fmv-marked, no quote on this plan) and GET /liquidity/pm for 'Another Fed rate hike in 2026?' (live Polymarket CLOB book, Saturday; PM books trade on weekends, so this one is live, not Friday's).

caps.per_order: <= 10% of the contract's daily volume and <= 5% of its open interest (every leg)

capacity.note: holding whose hedge (coverage x holding, delta-adjusted when the delta is known) fits one order inside both option caps

option_SPY_650_put_2026-12-18.label: Massive option snapshot: volume is the latest session's (Friday's on a weekend); spread from the last quote when the plan has quotes

cost_model.formula: cost_bp = half the quoted spread (bp of mid); option impact not modelled, the volume / open-interest caps keep orders small

caps.per_order: <= 50% of the book depth within 2 cents of the mid (side taken)

pm_polymarket_4620900.label: depth within 1/2/5 cents of the mid (buy = asks, sell = bids); Polymarket fills are simulated (no trading account)
